name: dashback
description: Automatically learns and completes Geometry Dash levels using a variety of algorithms.

enabled.name: Enable Solver
enabled.description: Master switch. When off, dashback does nothing and the game plays normally.

algorithm.name: Algorithm
algorithm.description: Which solver to run: backtracking, genetic, hillclimb, annealing, or random.

max-attempts.name: Max Attempts
max-attempts.description: Give up after this many attempts (0 = unlimited).

solve-speed.name: Solve Speed
solve-speed.description: Game speed multiplier while solving. Physics is fixed-step, so this only makes iteration faster without affecting determinism. Adjust live in-game with [ and ]. Reset to 1 when you leave the level.

search-granularity.name: Search Granularity
search-granularity.description: Frames the backtracking search steps by, for both hold start and hold length. 1 = every frame (fully complete). Higher scans faster but can miss frame-perfect inputs.

max-hold-length.name: Max Hold Length
max-hold-length.description: Longest single held input (frames) the backtracking search will try. Flight/ship sections need sustained holds, so this must be well above 1; longer thrusts are built from chained holds. Larger values enlarge the search.

population-size.name: Population Size (genetic)
population-size.description: Genomes per generation for the genetic algorithm.

mutation-rate.name: Mutation Rate (genetic/hillclimb)
mutation-rate.description: Probability a frame's hold bit flips within the mutation window.

mutation-window.name: Mutation Window (genetic/hillclimb)
mutation-window.description: How many frames around the death point mutations focus on. Larger explores more but slower to refine.

annealing-temperature.name: Annealing Temperature
annealing-temperature.description: Initial temperature for the annealing algorithm (in frames). Higher = more willing to accept worse candidates early. Cools automatically.

show-sensing.name: Show Obstacle Sensing (debug)
show-sensing.description: Overlay the sensed distance to the next hazard on the HUD, to validate the perception module. Does not affect solving.

auto-solve-daily.name: Auto-solve Daily (experimental)
auto-solve-daily.description: Attempt to automatically open and solve the Daily level. Not yet fully implemented.
